title: Determination of Pb2+ in natural water with a polymer electrode coupled with a flow analysis device
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00900B, Paper
Guiyun Zhang, Zhiwei Lai
A designed flow analysis device was used for the determination of Pb2+ in natural water coupled with a poly(pyrrole thiourea) electrode, and this method is suitable for application to drinking water detection.
